scope: Read-only comparison of official OpenAI and OpenRouter transcription contracts, then relevant Enjoy source and existing evidence. No paid inference or configuration changes were made.

sources.title: OpenAI File transcription
sources.claim: 25 MB file cap; supported formats; longer-input guidance; prompting, diarization and streaming behavior.
sources.limitations: Does not define MB in bytes or guarantee accuracy/latency for a particular file.

sources.title: OpenAI Create transcription API reference
sources.claim: Current model IDs, file formats, response formats, prompt/chunking strategy, timestamp and streaming constraints.
sources.limitations: API contract, not a long-form quality benchmark.

sources.title: OpenAI model catalog
sources.claim: Lists current transcription family including GPT Transcribe, GPT-4o Transcribe, GPT-4o Mini Transcribe, diarize and Whisper.
sources.limitations: Catalog does not replace endpoint-level parameter restrictions.

sources.title: OpenAI Whisper model page
sources.claim: whisper-1 remains an available transcription model.
sources.limitations: Use the transcription guide/reference for response and timestamp contract.

sources.title: OpenAI GPT-4o Transcribe model page
sources.claim: gpt-4o-transcribe is current in the OpenAI catalog.
sources.limitations: Endpoint reference is the source of response-format constraints.

sources.title: OpenAI GPT-4o Mini Transcribe model page
sources.claim: gpt-4o-mini-transcribe is current in the OpenAI catalog.
sources.limitations: Endpoint reference is the source of response-format constraints.

sources.title: OpenAI GPT-4o Transcribe Diarize model page
sources.claim: gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize is current in the OpenAI catalog.
sources.limitations: Endpoint reference and guide define diarized_json and chunking requirements.

sources.title: OpenRouter Speech-to-Text guide
sources.claim: Dedicated STT endpoint; JSON/multipart request contracts; verbose timestamps; multipart cap; provider option behavior; upstream timeout guidance.
sources.limitations: Base64 JSON maximum is not published; fields and options vary by matched provider/model.

sources.title: OpenRouter multimodal overview
sources.claim: Distinguishes audio input in Chat Completions from the dedicated STT endpoint.
sources.limitations: Overview does not establish timing behavior of each STT model.

sources.title: OpenRouter MicrosoftAI MAI-Transcribe 2 model page
sources.claim: Documents verbose_json segments, word timestamp request and Azure diarization option for MAI-Transcribe 2.
sources.limitations: Model page is not proof for Enjoy 53:57 performance.

sources.title: OpenRouter Transcription on OpenRouter
sources.claim: Explains dedicated endpoint, JSON/multipart options, routing limitations and timeout-oriented long-audio guidance.
sources.limitations: Product guidance, not a per-model service-level guarantee.

sources.title: Enjoy MAI Transcribe service
sources.claim: Uses dedicated OpenRouter STT endpoint with MAI 2, 60-second WAV chunks, 8 MB JSON safety limit, timestamp offsets and cancellation.
sources.limitations: Application policy, not provider limit proof.

sources.title: Enjoy MAI Transcribe 2 integration acceptance
sources.claim: Packaged active app passed a 5:23 video in six 60-second chunks with captions, IPA, seek and playback.
sources.limitations: Does not test the 53:57 file or establish general provider limits.

sources.title: Enjoy Cloudflare 53:57 runtime evidence
sources.claim: Exact file is 25,903,156 bytes and 3,237.744063 seconds; whole-file whisper and tiny-en failed, while short controls succeeded.
sources.limitations: Does not test OpenAI direct, OpenRouter MAI 2, or Cloudflare turbo.
